title: Yucatan
summary: Yucatan, originally called Huntik Spillwater, is a water ride based on Huntik: Secrets & Seekers, located at the Magicland theme park (formerly known as Rainbow Magicland). It opened in Rome in 2011. The ride features several large animatronic Titans, a Mayan temple and two 15 and 25 meter drops. It is one of two Huntik-themed attractions at the park, the other being the Huntik 5D dark ride.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• The ride features large animatronic versions of Breaker, Gareon and Gar-Ghoul, who projects water.
• The design of the temple appears to be based off Hernán Cortés' vault, with large statues of Umbra, the Shadow Jaguar making up the attraction.

'''Yucatan''', originally called '''Huntik Spillwater''', is a water ride based on ''[[Huntik: Secrets & Seekers]]'', located at the ''Magicland'' theme park (formerly known as ''Rainbow Magicland''). It opened in Rome in 2011. The ride features several large animatronic [[Titans]], a Mayan temple and two 15 and 25 meter drops. It is one of two Huntik-themed attractions at the park, the other being the ''[[Huntik 5D]]'' dark ride. ''<nowiki/>''

==Trivia ==
*The ride features large animatronic versions of [[Breaker]], [[Gareon]] and [[Gar-Ghoul]], who projects water.
*The design of the temple appears to be based off [[Hernán Cortés' vault]], with large statues of [[Umbra]], the Shadow Jaguar making up the attraction.
